title: Pop up "warning" in Chrome every time a play test happens with new tile sets - HOW do I disable warnings?

posts.author: Ultimacj
posts.body:
As the post says anytime I use new tile sets regardless of deleting a set, moving, refreshing it etc.  As soon as I hit a key OR auto run event is needed for movement, it interrupts the play test and this pops up.  Of course, I can close this out, but it started doing this since I've purchased new tile sets, this includes changing the tile set of a map (the error does not pop up if I use the OG set or another set that isn't new on an existing map).  All I want to do is DISABLE the warnings, nothing is wrong with the project itself.  All scripts etc run fine and the game itself runs fine but have to manually close out the warning in order for the play test to proceed.
I've never had this problem with MV and or previous versions of rpg maker give this odd pop up.  If a script/plugin did not work, the game would crash which makes sense.
Below is what pops up each and everytime I launch a play test.
And yes, I have disabled ALL plugins, I get another popup the same as before anytime I use any new tile sets.
MZ and tile sets are purchased directly through Steam and I haven't had this problem until recently.
Please assist all I want to know is where is the option to flip off warnings or potential warnings.
Thank You.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
your screenshot is useless because it shows the elements, not the console where the errors and warnings are listed.
can you please provide a screenshot of the console tab?
EDIT: OK, saw the console at the bottom.
However that is not even a warning, that is only a status message and has nothing to do with the popup.
it seems that you activated a plugin that automatically opens the developer tools and you need to disable that option inside that plugin.
and if you get a different error disabling all plugins, then we need a screenshot of that as well

posts.author: Ultimacj
posts.body:
Yet I don't know what the warning is though but this is what I get if I select 'console' after the inintal popup appears.
It also only appears once when the play test is launched initially, transferring to other areas while the current play test is active doesn't seem to trigger it again.
Is there not JUST an OFF switch or option just to "ignore" warnings or is that not a feature of the software?

posts.author: Ultimacj
posts.body:
Default levels is dimmed out and unselectable - so there is no hidden option or feature to just bypass warnings?  I get if somnething conflicts and crashes.  RM is very straight forward when it conflicts with something, again I didn't change or add any new plugins or edit the ones I had in the past. All I've done is added three new tile sets I've purchased from Steam to apply to the project and that's when this started showing up.
EDIT:  I was able to fiddle bit, this "warn" part here, would be the cause of it?
This never happened until I added new tile sets, unless a plugin dislikes a tileset all of a sudden?

posts.author: utunnels
posts.body: Looks like that. Maybe you can remove that line.

posts.author: Ultimacj
posts.body:
I looked into that, that's flipped off by default if you mean Visual Stellas Plugins.  I've never messed with this feature.  Now that I've set the value to TRUE it no longer produces this problem.  The wording of this is VERY confusing.  By saying 'TRUE'  you're telling the program you don't want a test mode. By default this was set to 'FALSE' as I never messed with this part of the plugin.
That seemed to fix the problem but as my original posts state, why would this NOT occur on older tilesets?  The pop up doesn't occur until I make a new map, copy paste, or make a new map with any new tilesets I'm using.  It also was triggered upon movement of the character.
